Hi Katie —

Quick update: I just got notified of our company Summit (leadership offsite + internal blackout) the week of July 20–24. A number of folks who would present (serving runtime and infra leads) will be traveling and unavailable that week. I want to avoid a half-staff demo.

Would you be open to moving the live session to early August? I can offer either Tuesday 4 Aug or Wednesday 5 Aug, same 11:00am ET slot. If those don't work, suggest alternatives and I'll coordinate.

I've attached an updated agenda (small changes to highlight routing & fallback flow) and a procurement checklist so your team can start the paperwork.

Apologies for the short notice — want to make sure you get the full team.

Thanks,

evelyn_hart@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0149

Evelyn —

Thanks for the heads up. Good call to push — we don't want a partial comp. If Acme pushes to Aug 4/5 we should be fine. Also, if procurement asks for any concessions because of the change, loop me in and I can approve small credits up to $X (see the renewal playbook).
